Visitors are estimated unique browsers, not verified people. Visits are browser-tab sessions; refreshes add page views. A game starts on its first move and finishes when all 25 boxes are claimed. Undoing and replaying the same game does not add another game. Opt-outs, blockers and bots can affect totals. Daily history is kept for 90 days; this view shows 30. Lifetime totals include older activity.
